## Mathilde Boissel {#title}

### Curriculum Vitæ

I have robust skills in statistics, modelling and programming. I am passionate about science and technology, and enjoy working in a team to overcome the challenges posed by the healthcare sector.

## Professional & Research Experience {data-icon=laptop}


### Biostatistician / Methodologist

Groupement des Hôpitaux de l'Institut Catholique de Lille (GHICL), DRCI, Méthodology Team

Lomme, France

06/2024 - Today

Activities: 

* Methodology: Protocol design, statistical plan, number of subjects (power), randomisation, GIRCI call for proposals expertise.
* Clinical data analysis: Bivariate tests, concordance, survival analysis, modelling (linear, logistic, often mixed for repeated or hierarchical data).
* Quality approach: ISO 9001 certification (in progress), implementation of Github repository & dev {R2Excel} R pkg.

### Part-time lecturer

Catholic University of Lille

Lille, France

09/2025 - 01/2026

Activities: 

* Lecturer Master 1 Data Managment for Biosciences (FGES), International students (Erasmus). Total hours: 30 hours/year. Biostatistics I.

### Biostatistician Engineer

UMR8199 - University of Lille & CNRS

Lille, France

10/2015 - 06/2024

Activities: *Statistical studies in genomic, diabete and obesity field*

* (Multi)omic analyses: GWAS, DEseq, EWAS, eQTL, mQTL, eQTM, rare variants, PGS, luciferase, MR.
* Methods: Modelling, ANOVA, Classification, Variable/model selection, Dimension reduction (ACP/t-SNE), machine learning and cross-validation, LASSO penalised model.
* Development & Programming: Automated and reproducible processing chains (pipelines, {renv} and {targets}, templates, R packages), visualisations and regular reports (Rmarkdown, Quarto).
* Big data: UKBioBank, All of US, VCF, database access (MongoDB, SQL, Arrow).
* Member of the RIS-CNRS Stat & Geno working group; Supervision (2023/2024) of the biostatistics group (2 to 3 engineers)

## <b class="fab fa-r-project"></b> Packages {data-icon=code}

```{r rpackages2, results = "asis", eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
mypackages <- data.frame(
  name = "R2Excel",
  title = "Produce Statistical Tables in *R*, Save Into (*2*) *Excel* File",
  authors = "Mathilde Boissel [aut, cre], Cassandra Chaldaureille [aut, cre], Sahara Graf [aut], Saïd Maallem [ctb], Laurène Norberciak [aut, cre], Cristian Preda [aut, cre], Stephane Verdun [aut]", 
  where = "GitHub", # or CRAN
  user = "mboissel", # user profile on Github
  since = "2024-12", # some date since when the package came out
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
format_packages(package = mypackages, author = "Mathilde Boissel", max = 57, output = "resume")
```
